cases.name: East Haven Jane Doe
cases.narrative: On 8/16/1975, her body was found by a truck driver, floating in a drainage ditch behind the former Bradlees department store on Frontage Road. She was wrapped in a canvas tarpaulin and she was gagged and bound by black antenna wire around her neck, waist and knees. One undisclosed item used to gag the victim indicated the murder happened locally.
